scope: San Antonio, Austin and Boerne business; public location and ordering paths were reviewed.

metrics.label: Advance notice requested / custom cakes
metrics.context: Website policy; Friday-after-3-p.m. response cutoff also applies. Orders require email confirmation.

observations.title: Clarify which kind of order a customer wants
observations.observed: The live homepage promotes a seasonal preorder, merchandise and shipped macarons, while Place an Order goes to a separate Square ordering site.
observations.improvement: Test a first choice of local pickup, shipped treats or custom celebration orders. Use the same labels in campaign links to the appropriate order flow.

observations.title: Give menus a phone-friendly companion
observations.observed: Regional menu links use an external QR-link service, and the catering link opens a PDF menu.
observations.improvement: Offer an HTML menu alongside PDFs, with item categories and location-specific order buttons. Maintain prices and availability from the same approved source.

limitations: Regional menu redirects were not fully reviewed; the catering PDF was retrievable. No broken-link finding is made.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
